hero_kicker: Electric motorcycles / designed in New Zealand
hero_lede: Adamar builds handcrafted electric motorcycles for riders who want real range and real character — from city commutes to the roads that don't have a name yet.
models_subheading: Every Adamar is built around the same electric platform, then shaped for a different way of riding.
about_body1: Welcome to Adamar Electric Motorcycles, where cutting-edge innovation seamlessly intertwines with a commitment to sustainability. Our dedication to quality is evident in our meticulous manufacturing processes and the handcrafted assembly of each motorcycle.
about_body2: Our strategic partnerships with businesses around the globe enable us to broaden our horizons while remaining steadfast in our core principles — merging modern design with practical functionality.
about_tagline_sub: Handcrafted electric motorcycles, built on sustainability and performance.
contact_body: Tell us which model you're curious about and where you're based — we'll get back to you to arrange a ride.
